what: The vaults this site uses. None as of v0.1.0. When one is created, only its READ key goes here; the write key is held by Dinis and exists nowhere in this repository. validate.js refuses any string carrying sgit's private-key prefix anywhere in the tree.

would_hold.records/: finder records people choose to publish, each with its permission line; the interviewer's
would_hold.interviews/: transcripts of interviews run by a model, with the person's permission
would_hold.findings/: what interviews showed about the questions, for the librarian
would_hold.plans/: a business plan written on this site, when there is one, in the shape of sgit.ai's plan vaults
